architecturalInvariants: Behaviour.fn_Observe is the only computation of behaviour. Consumption goes through Behaviour.fn_Read and Behaviour.fn_ReadSteps.
Growth.Routine NEVER owns a step list. It references Behaviour.Subject. Asserted structurally: no Step/EventType/Percent column may exist on Growth.Routine.
Routine completion is derived from logged events every time. No stored percentage, no mark-complete command, no completion endpoint. Asserted at the contract boundary too.
Goal achievement is earned from the timeline, forward-only, and refused to clients by validator and procedure.
Applicability for content, dashboard cards, goals and routines all go through Rules.fn_Match. One matcher.
